name: ClickHouse 26.8 LTS
description: Real-time analytics database with HTTPS, TLS native port and backups.

upstream.backup: alpine:3.24.2 + curl + rclone 1.76.0; backups use ClickHouse's BACKUP ... TO S3

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: Admin user created at boot (replaces ClickHouse's passwordless 'default' user).

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Password of CLICKHOUSE_USER, generated at deploy. Re-applied at every boot. Under 12 characters locks the login (see the deploy log).

CLICKHOUSE_DB.description: Database created on the first boot.

CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.description: 1 = CLICKHOUSE_USER may create users, roles and quotas with SQL (CREATE USER ...).

CLICKHOUSE_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days the system log tables (query_log, part_log, metric_log, trace_log, ...) keep rows.

CLICKHOUSE_EXTRA_CONFIG_XML.description: Optional extra server settings: a complete <clickhouse>...</clickhouse> document written to config.d at boot.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed certificate on the native TLS port 9440 (TCP proxy); renewed within 30 days of expiry.

PORT.description: ClickHouse HTTP port: public HTTPS domain, healthcheck (/ping), /play SQL console and /dashboard.

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: HTTP interface over the private network (clickhouse-js, clickhouse-connect, JDBC via http).

CLICKHOUSE_NATIVE_URL.description: Native protocol over the private network (clickhouse-go, clickhouse-client --host).

CLICKHOUSE_PUBLIC_NATIVE_URL.description: Native protocol with TLS through the TCP proxy (self-signed certificate; egress is billed).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time ClickHouse gets to finish queries and shut down cleanly on redeploy.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: Account that runs BACKUP/RESTORE (kept in sync by reference).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Bucket S3 endpoint (ClickHouse writes to it path-style).

BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key (sent to ClickHouse in the BACKUP statement; ClickHouse masks it in its logs).

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: rclone only (listing and retention). Keep false for Railway Buckets.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for ClickHouse before failing.

BACKUP_MAX_HOURS.description: Give up waiting for one BACKUP or RESTORE after this many hours.

RESTORE_RUN.description: Restore only (start command /usr/local/bin/clickhouse-backup restore): run folder, or latest.

RESTORE_DATABASE.description: Restore only: database to restore. Empty = CLICKHOUSE_DB.

RESTORE_TARGET.description: Restore only: NEW database name. Empty = {database}_restored; existing databases are never touched.
